record.what_it_does: All-in-one funnel builder, email marketing, courses and e-commerce platform.
record.auth_notes: Public API: the user creates a key in Settings > MCP & API keys (max 3 per account, unique names, optional expiry, key shown only once) and sends it in the X-API-Key header. The MCP server uses a separate MCP key, sent in the X-MCP-Key header or the mcpKey query parameter. No OAuth exists, so a multi-user toolkit would have each end user paste their own key.
record.access_notes: Any account holder creates keys in account settings, and the help article names no plan requirement. The pricing page has an "API requests per minute" row that differs by plan (search snapshots suggest 30/60/120/Unlimited, but the values did not render for me). This points to per-plan rate limits rather than a paywall. Free-plan API access is not explicitly confirmed by an official page.
record.api_breadth_notes: developer.systeme.io/llms.txt lists about 180 operations. They cover Contacts, ContactFields, Tags, Automation rules, Booking calendar, Community (communities, memberships, topics, posts), Domains, Files, Funnels and steps, Mailing (newsletters, campaigns, campaign steps, automation emails, statistics), Page editor, Payment (coupons, price plans, digital and physical products, offers, sale settings), SMS, School (courses, modules, lectures, enrollments), Subscriptions, Webhooks CRUD, Workflows (beta) and Workspace members. Collections use cursor pagination. The API is built on API Platform (Hydra-style resource names).
record.mcp_notes: Official remote server at https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOURMCPKEY. The MCP key goes in the X-MCP-Key header or the mcpKey query parameter. The server is an initial release covering contacts, tags, contact fields and newsletters only. All MCP keys share one rate-limit quota. A community local server also exists (snzeeee/mcp-server-systeemio).
record.blocker_notes: There is no OAuth, so authentication uses a per-user API key (3 keys per account). Webhooks can be registered through the API (POST /api/webhooks) for six events: CONTACT_OPT_IN, CONTACT_CREATED, CONTACT_TAG_ADDED, CONTACT_TAG_REMOVED, SALE_NEW and SALE_CANCELED. Rate limits vary by plan.
